image_description: A street scene featuring two modified golf carts. The foreground cart is black with a driver wearing a helmet and goggles; it has a custom front bumper and appears to have a roll cage. The background cart is green, heavily decorated with red ribbons/flowers, and carries multiple passengers. The setting appears to be an urban or semi-urban area with buildings and signage in the background, rather than a golf course.
